open_questions.question: Are there existing operational constraints or integration dependencies not listed?
What are target latency, throughput, and availability SLOs?

risks.description: Potential loss of functionality during migration.
risks.mitigation: Implement comprehensive testing to ensure functionality is preserved.
Conduct performance benchmarks and optimize Go code.

out_of_scope: Development of new features not present in the Kotlin codebase.
Major architectural redesigns beyond necessary migration adjustments.

relationships: LegacyInput contract must map deterministically to ModernizedOutput contract

standards_guidance.name: Android Architecture: MVVM + Unidirectional State Flow
engineering_actions: Keep UI state in a ViewModel exposed as StateFlow or Compose State.
Treat ViewModel as the single source of truth for screen-level state.
Emit one-shot side effects via a Channel / SharedFlow, not LiveData.

standards_guidance.name: Jetpack Compose-First UI
engineering_actions: New screens must be Composable functions; legacy XML layouts are interop bridges only.
Preview every screen with `@Preview` variants for light / dark / RTL.
Use Material 3 components unless an explicit design-system override exists.

standards_guidance.name: Offline-First Data Policy
engineering_actions: Reads must resolve from local cache first; network refresh is async.
Mutations enqueue to WorkManager or an equivalent persistent queue.
Conflict resolution is explicit (last-writer-wins or merge), never silent.

standards_guidance.name: Mobile Security Baseline
engineering_actions: Secrets at rest go through Android Keystore, never SharedPreferences.
Network calls to private APIs must use certificate pinning.
Release builds must enable R8 / ProGuard with keep rules for reflection points.

non_negotiables: All user-visible strings must be in string resources for localization.
No network calls on the main thread — use coroutines with Dispatchers.IO.
Every screen has at least one Compose preview and one instrumented test.
Release builds must pass lint with `-Werror` for critical severity rules.
